items.question: By what derivational rule does the root śam yield the form ḍhaḥ?
premises: The root śam serves as the derivational base.
The suffix ḍha is applied to that base.
The marker iti indicates the resulting derived form.
items.inference: Applying the suffix ḍha to the root śam produces the form ḍhaḥ.
uncertainties: The precise grammatical framework or sūtra context for this derivation is not explicit in the verse alone.
